purpose: Teach: レフ/栄養素/ボーイング

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 撮影のレフ板配置を最適化しましょう
lines.en: Let's optimize how we place the reflector boards for the shoot.
lines.style: Light purposeful open; polite energy, gently rising suggestion rather than an order.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社員の栄養素摂取をアプリで管理します
lines.en: Sure. I'll track everyone's nutrient intake through the app.
lines.style: Easy agreeable pickup; relaxed mid-pace, faint wry amusement at the wellness-app angle.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 海外子会社の出張で米国便はボーイング機が便利ですね
lines.en: For trips out to the US subsidiary, the Boeing flights really are the convenient option, aren't they.
lines.style: Thinking-aloud observation; soft even tone, a small considering pause before the tag ending.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。栄養素表示を全製品に追加します
lines.en: Yes. I'll get nutrient labeling added across the full product line.
lines.style: Steady can-do confirmation; unhurried delivery, quietly ticking the task onto his mental list.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: スタジオのレフ機材リストを社内で共有しましょう
lines.en: And let's share the studio's reflector equipment list with the whole office.
lines.style: Wrap-up warmth; slightly brighter lift, then a gentle downward settle closing the topic.
